outputs.mpt: Maximum phonation time: length of the longest continuous voiced segment (s)
outputs.start: Start of the longest segment from the beginning of the recording (s)
outputs.end: End of the longest segment from the beginning of the recording (s)
outputs.segments: Number of voiced segments of at least min_segment; more than 1 = several attempts (-)
outputs.truncated: 1 when the longest segment reaches the start or the end of the file and the time is only a lower bound, otherwise 0 (-)

max_gap.description: Longest voicing dropout that still belongs to the same phonation (s); 0 = none

min_segment.description: Shortest voiced segment that counts as a phonation (s)

f_min.description: Lowest F0 still taken as voice (Hz); lower than for F0 so that a voice that drops an octave lower is counted

strength_threshold.description: Minimum tone strength below which a frame is unvoiced
